files.title: File:Brookside Farm house from SE.JPG
files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption: Stone farm house at Brookside Farm, also known as Gridley-Howe-Faden-Atkins Farmstead, located on west side of Nebraska Highway 71 just south of Lodgepole Creek; seen from the southeast.  The house was built in 1899.  The farm is listed in the National Register of Historic Places.

A stone house is almost completely hidden by the trees at left, behind the two utility poles.  The farm is listed in the National Register of Historic Places.
